## Live replacement

**Live file swap: none.** ROM mod + relaunch. The template hook applies when a part list is built, so a new wrestler appears only after a launch; live-inject.md lists No Mercy as build only

**Pick whip: partial.** slots_on_screen boxes each slot from its parts' forced MVP matrices in the frame's display list; used by characters op=extract x,y. pick_tool does not use it: N64 is not in LIVE_PLATFORMS, so pick_replace is build mode

**Live controls:** none specific; characters op=extract session_id [x y] reads the wrestler from session RAM

### RAM / runtime hooks (curated)

| hook | address | what | status | source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| part list per slot | `0x800A8980 + 0x270*slot` | 24 entries {u16 model, texture, palette, u8 skin, x} at +0x08..+0xC0; face texture u16 at +0xA2 identifies the wrestler | proven_read | gbox/aki_wrestling.py identify / slots_on_screen |
| wrestler in slot | `0x80076264 + 2*slot (s16)` | wrestler number per slot | unverified | gbox/aki_wrestling.py SLOT_WRESTLER |
| roster costume records | `*(0x80047E90) + 0x138*n` | 4 x 0x4E costume records per wrestler; copying them over The Rock's at Superstar Select loads another wrestler | proven_write | gbox/aki_wrestling.py capture_wrestlers (private emulator) |
| wrestler objects | `0x800A11FC + 0xB24*slot` | position floats at +4 | unverified | docs/model_swaps.md section 9 |
| modded file table | `0x80700000` | moved table + hook + templates in Expansion Pak RAM | unverified | gbox/aki_wrestling.py RAM_EXP |

## Gaps before a live swap / pick whip

- No live model write: new parts need new file ids in a rebuilt file table, so no RAM-only swap path exists
- pick_identify has no No Mercy backend; slots_on_screen is not wired into the whip
- Writer is NW4E rev 1 only; Europe 2e8850a2a6c53375 refused
- Wrestlers sharing a face (Cactus Jack / Mick Foley) are replaced together; CAW slots not covered
- Cast-swap builds (GTA LCS peds) not verified in game
